name: Kno2 Connected Brand Guide

usageNotes.brandMark: The Kno2 icon uses a trio of blues with overlapping gradients.

metadataManagement.requirement: Use this JSON for UI metadata enforcement across workspaces.
metadataManagement.scope: All Power BI workspaces and report templates.

brandMission: Democratize healthcare communication by enabling seamless and secure interoperability across the healthcare ecosystem through a single API.
brandPromise: Kno2 Connected signifies seamless healthcare communication integration, adherence to industry standards, enhanced interoperability, and validated compatibility with the Kno2 ecosystem.

partnership: <Partner> announces its partnership with Kno2 (R), the company leading the future of healthcare communication.
<Partner> announces its partnership with Kno2 (R), a purpose-driven company democratizing healthcare communication for secure, effortless, and maximized exchange of patient information.
network: Kno2's network enables secure, effortless, and maximized exchange of patient information.
Connect once to Kno2 and gain access to a powerful network of connected organizations, technologies, and interoperability frameworks.
qhin: <Organization> has selected Kno2 as their national healthcare communication infrastructure, including QHIN services.
<Organization> is excited to announce our partnership with Kno2 as our official QHIN partner.

logoUsage.preferred: Full-color Kno2 icon with blue dots
logoUsage.alternate: Full-color Kno2 icon with white dots (only if needed)
logoUsage.notes: Maintain correct aspect ratio and clear space; confirm minimum on-screen dimension in the brand deck.

editorial.nameUsage: Kno2 is one word; never abbreviate as K2.
editorial.trademark: Include registered trademark symbol (R) after the first reference to the organization name.
editorial.connectedPhrase: Use 'Kno2 Connected' in public references; 'connected by Kno2' is acceptable for grammar.

thirdPartyBranding.Carequality: Carequality is a framework, not a network; no italicized 'e' in plain text.
thirdPartyBranding.TEFCA: Use the full name 'Trusted Exchange Framework and Common Agreement (TEFCA)'.
